selected_evidence.requirement: inventory-worker managed service under dedicated inventorysvc account
selected_evidence.summary: The unit is enabled and active, uses the required executable, and declares User/Group inventorysvc. The live process has UID/GID 999 matching the dedicated non-login account.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 35c87ec9-1707-4fb3-ab1d-f264d3618caa, received safe-reboot acknowledgement, observed new boot ID 83d38081-8031-4a2f-8afb-a1c7fc356b13, and confirmed the system, enabled service, and inventorysvc-owned worker process recovered.

commands.command:
set -eu
if ! getent group inventorysvc >/dev/null; then sudo -n groupadd --system inventorysvc; fi
if ! getent passwd inventorysvc >/dev/null; then sudo -n useradd --system --gid inventorysvc --home-dir /nonexistent --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin inventorysvc; fi
printf '%s\n' '[Unit]' 'Description=Inventory worker' 'After=local-fs.target' '' '[Service]' 'Type=simple' 'User=inventorysvc' 'Group=inventorysvc' 'ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker' 'Restart=on-failure' 'RestartSec=5s' 'NoNewPrivileges=true' 'PrivateTmp=true' '' '[Install]' 'WantedBy=multi-user.target' | sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service >/dev/null
sudo -n chown root:root /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service
sudo -n chmod 0644 /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable inventory-worker.service
sudo -n systemctl start inventory-worker.service
printf 'configured=ok\n'

set -eu
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf '%s\n' '--- account ---'
getent passwd inventorysvc
getent group inventorysvc
printf '%s\n' '--- service state ---'
systemctl is-active inventory-worker.service
systemctl is-enabled inventory-worker.service
systemctl show inventory-worker.service -p User -p Group -p ExecStart -p MainPID -p SubState -p NRestarts
pid=$(systemctl show inventory-worker.service -p MainPID --value)
test "$pid" -gt 1
printf '%s\n' '--- live process identity ---'
ps -o pid=,ppid=,user=,group=,stat=,args= -p "$pid"
printf 'proc_uid_fields='; sed -n 's/^Uid:[[:space:]]*//p' "/proc/$pid/status"
printf 'cmdline='; tr '\000' ' ' < "/proc/$pid/cmdline"; printf '\n'
printf '%s\n' '--- unit definition ---'
systemctl cat inventory-worker.service
